name: Healing
body:
Cost +2 bonus; Aura moderate conjuration; CL 3rd; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

A healing weapon can deliver restorative energy. When hitting an opponent, the wielder can decide to heal the target instead of harming it. The weapon cures a number of hit points equal to the damage it would have normally inflicted. Constructs and objects are unaffected by this ability; against undead, a healing weapon actually inflicts 1-1/2 times the usual damage. A critical hit with a healing weapon doesn’t increase the healing or have a critical hit effect.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells cure moderate wounds; Special creator must be good
